name: Import & export
subtitle: A migration usually arrives as a file somebody exported from the site being replaced. Paste it here rather than retyping it.

elements.label: Paste CSV to import
elements.hint: A header row is detected if present; from and to are the only required columns and everything else falls back to a sensible default. A rule that already exists is updated rather than duplicated, so a corrected file can simply be pasted again.

elements.label: Every rule, as CSV
elements.hint: Select all and copy. A plugin cannot stream a file download — every request it serves goes through Ovynt's generic module endpoints, which always answer with JSON — so this is a text box rather than a button.
